1 | PASS | `src/components/Auth.tsx` implements registration via `supabase.auth.signUp` and login via `signInWithPassword`.
2 | PASS | `src/components/Auth.tsx` implements login functionality using `supabase.auth.signInWithPassword` with error handling.
3 | PASS | `src/components/Lobby.tsx` and `GameRoom.tsx` implement logout via `supabase.auth.signOut` and router refresh.
4 | FAIL | `DrawingCanvas.tsx` broadcasts strokes via Supabase Realtime, but lacks logic to handle concurrent drawing or cursor sync for all players effectively.
5 | FAIL | `GameRoom.tsx` sets `is_drawing` on join/start but lacks logic to rotate turns automatically or enforce single drawer state changes dynamically.
6 | FAIL | `DrawingCanvas.tsx` passes `word` prop, but `GameRoom.tsx` generates a random word string instead of fetching from the vocabulary list, failing requirement 7.
7 | FAIL | `GameRoom.tsx` uses a hardcoded array `["apple", "ball"...]` for word selection instead of importing/using the `VOCABULARY` constant from `src/lib/constants.ts`.
8 | PASS | `src/components/Chat.tsx` provides a live chat interface using Supabase Realtime to broadcast and receive guess messages in real time.
9 | FAIL | `Chat.tsx` inserts messages but lacks server-side or client-side logic to compare guesses against the round word and update `is_correct` status.
10 | FAIL | `PlayerList.tsx` displays scores, but no logic exists to increment scores upon correct guesses or update the database accordingly.
11 | PASS | `GameRoom.tsx` and `DrawingCanvas.tsx` use Supabase Realtime channels to broadcast strokes, chat, and state updates without page reloads.
12 | PASS | `GameRoom.tsx` displays "Waiting", "Playing", and "Finished" states with appropriate UI elements and buttons for game flow.
13 | PASS | `supabase_schema.sql` defines tables for profiles, scores, and game data with RLS, and `Auth.tsx` creates profiles on signup.
14 | PASS | `src/components/Lobby.tsx` fetches and displays a list of public rooms from the `game_rooms` table.
15 | PASS | `Lobby.tsx` displays room name, `current_players`, and `max_players` for each room card in the lobby grid.
16 | PASS | `Lobby.tsx` provides a "Join" button for rooms that are not full and not in progress, redirecting to the game page.
17 | PASS | `Lobby.tsx` subscribes to `postgres_changes` on `game_rooms` to update the list in real time as rooms are created or updated.
18 | PASS | `Lobby.tsx` visually indicates "In Progress" or "Full" status with distinct colors and disabled buttons for full rooms.
19 | PASS | `supabase_schema.sql` stores `stroke_data` as JSONB with timestamps, and `DrawingCanvas.tsx` saves strokes in order.
20 | PASS | `GameRoom.tsx` switches to `ReplayViewer` when a round ends, allowing players to watch the drawing sequence.
21 | PASS | `ReplayViewer.tsx` implements Play, Pause, and Restart controls using state management and animation frames.
22 | FAIL | `ReplayViewer.tsx` runs local animation loops; there is no synchronization mechanism (e.g., shared timestamp/seek) for simultaneous viewing.
23 | PASS | `supabase_schema.sql` persists strokes in `drawing_strokes` table, ensuring data survives session duration and page reloads.

rubric.4: Application provides a real-time multiplayer drawing canvas that broadcasts drawing activity to all connected players without requiring page refreshes.
rubric.5: Application implements a turn-taking system that designates exactly one player as the drawing player while all other players act as guessers.
rubric.6: Application assigns a vocabulary word to the drawing player at the start of each turn and ensures that only that player can see the word.
rubric.7: Application ensures that all vocabulary words are drawn from an age-appropriate list suitable for elementary school students.
rubric.8: Application provides a live chat interface that allows players to submit guesses in real time.
rubric.9: Application automatically detects when a player’s guess matches the correct word and updates game state accordingly.
rubric.10: Application tracks and updates scores for each player based on correct guesses and defined scoring rules.
rubric.11: Application delivers real-time updates for drawing strokes, guesses, scores, and turn changes to all players without requiring page reloads.
rubric.12: Application implements clear game start and game end states so players understand when a match begins, progresses, and concludes.
rubric.13: Application persists all user accounts and player score data using durable database-backed storage.
rubric.14: Application provides a lobby view that lists all available public rooms.
rubric.15: Application displays for each public room in the lobby its name or identifier, the current number of players, and the maximum capacity.
rubric.16: Application allows users to select and join any public room that is not full.
rubric.17: Application updates lobby information in real time as players join rooms, leave rooms, or new rooms are created.
rubric.18: Application clearly indicates in the lobby when a room is full and when it is currently in progress.
rubric.19: Application records the drawing strokes for each round in a manner that preserves their exact order and timing.
rubric.20: Application allows players, after a round ends and the correct word has been revealed, to watch a replay of that round’s drawing.
rubric.21: Application provides replay playback controls, including at minimum play, pause, and restart.
rubric.22: Application ensures replays are synchronized for all players who choose to view them simultaneously.
rubric.23: Application persists or caches replay data for at least the duration of the game session so players can rewatch recent rounds.
